_about: Reviewed verdicts on ReBorn patch sites, keyed by ReBorn VA. skip = not a layout patch, ignored; reject = a layout patch we will not port, so its function stays unpatched. Addresses and reasons only - no bytes. Read by re/py/x86/reborn_emit.py.

0x008156E8.why: ReBorn's own config loader (reads the SR_* keys from Settings.cfg, runs its layout init, then the engine's FULLSCREEN reader). The SDK reads [hd] and computes the layout itself.
